'''Scarlet Velvet''' is a quest-exclusive [[NPC]] who previously had an arrangement with the [[Montelli Family]], acting as an intermediary between them and the common folk, particularly in transactions involving the new [[Ragunna Terminal|Terminals]] that disrupted the [[Order of the Deep|Order]]'s monopoly. Their dealings also extended to perfumes and other goods.

However, the partnership ended abruptly due to [[Capollo Montelli]]'s interference with the Order, which caused significant trouble for Scarlet, leading her to sever ties with the Montellis. Scarlet could only be contacted through one of her associates, [[Ernesto]], who worked as a bartender to gather intelligence for their operations.

She was a close friend of [[Benett]], the former [[Averardo Vault]] Keeper, before his death during the events of {{Quest|If On a Rainy Night a Family}}.

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(After completing {{Quest|If On a Rainy Night a Family}}, she can be found on the outskirt of [[Egla Town]])
:'''Scarlet Velvet''': Hey, {{Rover}}. Good to see you again.
:{{DIcon}} It's been a while.
:{{DIcon}} You're looking cheerful today.
:'''Scarlet Velvet''': Well, I owe that to you and [[Carlotta]]. Thanks to your efforts, we've been able to restart our cooperation with the Montelli family, along with others whose ties had been severed. 
:'''Scarlet Velvet''': The Reserved Terminal is still a sensitive subject in public, but at least now, people here are free to explore in the wild and gather Echoes as they please.
:'''Scarlet Velvet''': Honestly, I was shocked when Carlotta asked if I'd be interested in joining your plan. I never imagined you'd outmaneuver the Order and strike a deal with [[Capollo Montelli|Capollo]], forcing him to hand over the core data module.
:'''Scarlet Velvet''': But in highsight, trusting you, Carlotta... and Benett's judgement turned out to be the right decision. 
:'''Scarlet Velvet''': Capollo's been removed and dealt with by the family. Carlotta's busy managing the aftermath alongside [[Francesco Montelli|Padrino]] while also focusing on charting a new sea route.
:{{DIcon}} A new sea route? Where to?
::'''Scarlet Velvet''': The exact route hasn't been finalized yet, but it's rumored to span three or four countries.
:{{DIcon}} Looks like Montelli's ambitions are growing.
::'''Scarlet Velvet''': Carlotta told me it was your brilliance that made this possible. Your performance at the [[Carnevale]] was so inspiring that more and more people are rallying behind Montelli, eager to explore a bigger, grander world.
:'''Scarlet Velvet''': We're still figuring out what ventures to take on and what we truly want to achieve. This time, I'm determined to make the right call too.
:'''Scarlet Velvet''': {{Rover}}, just sit tight—we'll bring you some good news soon!
{{Dialogue End}}
